items.description: Manchester United failed to ease the pressure on Michael Carrick as they were beaten 2-0 at Atletico Madrid in the Champions League after Leny Yoro’s controversial second-half sending off.

items.title: Neto Borges goes from zero to hero by hitting Boro winner in five-goal thriller
items.description: Brazilian defender Neto Borges bagged a dramatic injury-time winner after earlier scoring an own goal as Championship high-fliers Middlesbrough secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over battling Stoke.

items.title: Martinez issues blistering criticism of Man Utd board after loss
items.description: Lisandro Martinez launches a blistering attack on Manchester United's hierarchy for not strengthening the squad following qualification for the Champions League.

items.title: Russo, James both score twice as England beat Greece in World Cup play-off
items.description: Alessia Russo and Lauren James reiterated their importance to England as both scored twice in a 5-0 win against Greece in the second leg of their World Cup play-off first-round tie, winning 8-1 on aggregate.

items.title: Toth stars in goal as Blackburn secure narrow win at Bristol City
items.description: A magnificent goalkeeping display from Balazs Toth inspired Blackburn to a 1-0 Sky Bet Championship victory over Bristol City at Ashton Gate.
